root_cause: The production snapshot workflow required NETLIFY_MCP_PROXY_PATH_TEMP before checking whether the repository's normal Git-linked Netlify production deploy had already promoted the exact main SHA. This caused a false terminal transport failure even when Netlify successfully deployed the same commit automatically.
prevention_rule: On protected-main push, production transport first performs a bounded exact-SHA readback window for the Git-linked Netlify deploy. Only if that deploy does not arrive may the MCP proxy fallback be required. Exact identity and pricing-content proof remain mandatory after either route.

evidence.observed_failure: Production Source Snapshot run 35731547098 exited 78 for a missing proxy secret while Netlify deploy 6ab27dd13d0efe0008d63bce independently reached ready with commit_ref 4461fa27eb84f05600db0b5d0b4ff176f1952569.
evidence.production_readback: Pending protected merge and push-triggered exact identity plus pricing content proof.
